fusions.name: Springboard Crash
fusions.desc: You spring high off the bent staff and crash down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Damp Flick
fusions.desc: You snap the wet end of the staff to fling a gob of water at the first enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Hop
fusions.desc: You pole-hop 5 tiles forward on the staff, then move 20% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Crouch
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, you crouch low on the staff and your physical damage rises 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
